question: The lush cloud forest crowning Green Mountain on Ascension Island came to exist how?
choices: It is a relic of ancient rainforest that predates the island's volcanoes
It sprang up after a 19th-century shipwreck scattered seeds
It grew from plants that drifted across the ocean on currents
It was deliberately planted by humans on a once-barren island
anchorText: one of the few large-scale planned forests
